2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122830 (county Elections page, NOVEMBER 5, 2024 'COUNTY-WIDE'; ElectionName '2024 General'). Vote-type labels are shifted: the 'Election Day' type is already complete at 7:07 PM and never changes (sum of all candidate cells 100,778 in every version through 11/15/2024), so it holds early in-person votes; the 'EV Mail' type fills in during the night and holds the election-day returns. Opened v350804 (Timestamp 11/5/2024 7:07:09 PM CST): President, REP Trump/Vance 'Election Day' 4885 (<Precinct Calvert 1 votes=457>), 'EV Mail' 0 in all precincts. Opened v351866 (9:06:33 PM CST): 'EV Mail' 1189 for Trump/Vance, 13 precincts nonzero (Calvert 1 votes=100), contest-wide EV Mail sum 27,640. Only one night update (9:06 PM) carries the election-day-type numbers; next version is 11/15. Script literal reading (label 'Election Day'): 2 of 2 night updates, 1 distinct release.

2026_primary.fact: Clarity EID 126055 ('2026 Primary Election'). 'Election Day' label constant at sum 69,120 from 7:03 PM through 3/11 (early votes). 'EV Mail' (election-day returns) sums: v368385 7:03:34 PM CST 0; v368428 8:17:27 PM 6,329 in 2 precincts; v368459 8:59:24 PM 50,433 in 12 precincts; v368471 9:15:56 PM, 13 precincts (REP US Senator John Cornyn EV Mail 496, Calvert 1 votes=46). Election-day precinct numbers in 3 night updates. Script literal reading: 4 of 4 night updates with 'Election Day' precinct votes, 1 distinct release.

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity EID 126389 ('2026 Primary Runoff'). v372896 at 5/26/2026 4:23:27 PM CDT (before polls closed) already has 'Election Day' 3,741 (sum) in 13 precincts, unchanged afterward, confirming that label holds early votes. 'EV Mail' (election-day returns): v372948 7:50:30 PM CDT 864 in 2 precincts (Wheelock 3, Benchley 11; Cornyn 28 and 32); v372979 8:31:08 PM CDT 3,666 in 13 precincts. Election-day precinct numbers in 2 night updates. Script literal reading: 2 of 2.

rationale: Primary and runoff LIVE by check 1 (election-day returns, carried under the 'EV Mail' label, appear by precinct in two or more election-night Clarity updates); 2024 END. Two LIVE give LIVE_PRECINCT, high. The literal script reading (label 'Election Day') also gives LIVE for all three.

comparison_notes.2024_general: same result (END, check 1), different reasoning. Research (reconciled LIVE to END) counts 1 distinct release of the 'Election Day'-labelled precinct votes. I find that label holds early votes (complete at 7:07 PM, unchanged through 11/15); the election-day returns are under 'EV Mail', which appear in only one night update (9:06 PM). Either way END.
comparison_notes.2026_primary: different: research END (1 distinct release of the 'Election Day' label across 4 night updates); I LIVE. The 'Election Day' label is constant (sum 69,120) from 7:03 PM to the 3/11 final, so it is not the election-day count. The 'EV Mail' type grows through the night: 0 at 7:03 PM, 6,329 in 2 precincts at 8:17 PM, 50,433 in 12 precincts at 8:59 PM, 13 precincts at 9:15 PM. That is election-day precinct returns in 3 night updates.
comparison_notes.2026_runoff: different: research END; I LIVE. The 4:23 PM CDT update (before polls closed) already holds the full 'Election Day'-labelled numbers (research itself notes 'likely early votes'), so the label is early voting. 'EV Mail' appears at 7:50 PM in 2 precincts (864) and at 8:31 PM in 13 precincts (3,666): 2 night updates with election-day precinct returns.
